purpose.summary: This is a large production COBOL program (ORCGI01) that handles hospital admission/discharge registration (入退院登録) as part of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system. It manages patient admission records, insurance combinations, ward/room assignments, discharge processing, and related billing calculations for Japanese medical institutions.

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in a Japanese encoding (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese text in comments to appear as mojibake. The program is part of the well-known open-source ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) project used in Japanese medical clinics and hospitals. The COPY statements reference zero copybooks counted mechanically (copy_count=0), which may indicate the copybooks were not separately indexed or the count reflects a different metric. The source is clearly genuine COBOL and not generated code.
